title: Archer pawn on DPC 0.9.29: aim camera, body follow, reticle experiment
intro: About 1 minute, two parts, each started with End. Arisen must be an Archer; an Archer pawn in the party.

steps.text: Releasing possession; installing the reticle hook
steps.each_frame:
if not _G.AIMZ then
  local A = { n = 0 }
  _G.AIMZ = A
  local td = sdk.find_type_definition("app.ui020801"); local m = td and td:get_method("requestDraw(via.Point, System.Single, System.Boolean)")
  if m then
    sdk.hook(m, function(args)
      pcall(function()
        if A.mine then A.mine_n = (A.mine_n or 0) + 1; return end
        A.n = A.n + 1
        local i = sdk.to_int64(args[3]); A.i = i
        local x, y = i & 0xFFFFFFFF, (i >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        A.x0 = math.min(A.x0 or x, x); A.x1 = math.max(A.x1 or x, x); A.y0 = math.min(A.y0 or y, y); A.y1 = math.max(A.y1 or y, y)
        A.raw4 = sdk.to_int64(args[4])
        local ok, f = pcall(sdk.to_float, args[4]); A.f = ok and f or nil
        A.b = (sdk.to_int64(args[5]) & 1) == 1
      end)
    end, function(r) return r end)
    A.hooked = true
  else A.hooked = false end
else
  local A = _G.AIMZ
  A.n, A.x0, A.x1, A.y0, A.y1, A.i, A.f, A.b, A.raw4, A.mine_n, A.p_t0, A.pt, A.r_res, A.phase, A.snap, A.s_t0, A.r_fail, A.t_err = 0
end

steps.text: 1/2 BASELINE. As the ARISEN (Archer, bow out). Press End, then HOLD AIM for 6 s and turn the camera a little
ARISEN: HOLD AIM now, turn the camera a little... keep holding

steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMZ; if not A then return end
A.s_t0 = A.s_t0 or os.clock()
if not A.snap and os.clock() - A.s_t0 > 1.5 then A.snap = { i = A.i, f = A.f, b = A.b, n = A.n } end

steps.text: 2/2 PAWN on DPC 0.9.29. Possess the ARCHER pawn (F6 / F7). Press End, then HOLD AIM for 16 s, turn the camera, shoot at something. Phase 1 (8 s): camera + reticle. Phase 2 (8 s): + arrows steered to the screen centre
PAWN: HOLD AIM, turn, shoot. Watch the 'phase' line: zoom? reticle? where do arrows land?
steps.each_frame:
local A = _G.AIMZ; if not A then return end
A.p_t0 = A.p_t0 or os.clock()
local dt = os.clock() - A.p_t0
A.phase = dt < 8 and "1: camera + reticle" or "2: + arrows to screen centre"
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return end
local ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"); if not ch then return end
local up = tostring(H.node(ch, 1) or "")
if not (up:find("Job02", 1, true) and not up:find("WithoutAim", 1, true)) then return end
if not A.r_fail then
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.GuiManager"); local ui = gm:get_field("Aim")
    if not A.pt then
      local x, y, src
      local c = A.snap
      if c and c.i then x, y, src = c.i & 0xFFFFFFFF, (c.i >> 32) & 0xFFFFFFFF, "captured" end
      if not (x and x > 0 and x < 20000 and y > 0 and y < 20000) then
        local sz = ui:get_field("ScreenSize"); x, y, src = math.floor(sz.w / 2), math.floor(sz.h / 2), "screen centre"
      end
      local pt = ValueType.new(sdk.find_type_definition("via.Point"))
      pcall(function() pt:set_field("x", x); pt:set_field("y", y) end)
      local okr, rx = pcall(pt.get_field, pt, "x")
      if not (okr and rx == x) then pt:write_dword(0, x); pt:write_dword(4, y) end
      A.pt, A.pt_s = pt, src .. " " .. x .. "," .. y
      local f = c and c.f
      if not (type(f) == "number" and f > 0.01 and f < 20) then f = 1.0 end
      A.pf, A.pb = f, (c and c.b) == true
    end
    A.mine = true
    local okc, e2 = pcall(ui.call, ui, "requestDraw(via.Point, System.Single, System.Boolean)", A.pt, A.pf, A.pb)
    A.mine = false
    if not okc then error(e2) end
    A.r_res = "reticle requested at " .. A.pt_s .. " scale " .. tostring(A.pf) .. " flag " .. tostring(A.pb)
  end)
  if not ok then A.mine = false; A.r_fail = true; A.r_res = "reticle failed: " .. tostring(err) end
end
if dt >= 8 then
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local tr = sdk.get_primary_camera():call("get_GameObject"):call("get_Transform")
    local p, z = tr:call("get_Position"), tr:call("get_WorldMatrix")[2]
    ch:call("set_AimTargetPosition", Vector3f.new(p.x - z.x * 60.0, p.y - z.y * 60.0, p.z - z.z * 60.0))
  end)
  if not ok and not A.t_err then A.t_err = tostring(err) end
end

probes.ctl:

local c = mcc:get_field("_CurrentCameraController"); return c and c:get_type_definition():get_name()
probes.t_up:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
return H.node(mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"), 1)
probes.yawd:
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CameraManager"); local mcc = cm and cm:call("getMainCameraController", 0); if not mcc then return nil end
local ch = mcc:call("get_TargetCharacter"); if not ch then return nil end
local z = ch:call("get_Transform"):call("get_AxisZ")
local m = sdk.find_type_definition("app.PlayerInputProcessorDetail"):get_method("getCameraAngleRad")
local d = math.deg(math.atan(z.x, z.z)) - math.deg(m:call(nil))
d = (d + 180) % 360 - 180; return math.abs(d)
probes.cap:
local A = _G.AIMZ; if not A then return nil end
return string.format("hooked=%s n=%s x=%s..%s y=%s..%s f=%s raw4=%s b=%s", tostring(A.hooked), tostring(A.n), tostring(A.x0), tostring(A.x1), tostring(A.y0), tostring(A.y1), tostring(A.f), tostring(A.raw4), tostring(A.b))
probes.flow: local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.GuiManager"); local ui = gm and gm:get_field("Aim"); return ui and ui:get_field("FlowNow")
probes.isdraw: local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.GuiManager"); local ui = gm and gm:get_field("Aim"); return ui and ui:get_field("IsDraw")
probes.screen: local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.GuiManager"); local ui = gm and gm:get_field("Aim"); if not ui then return nil end; local z = ui:get_field("ScreenSize"); return tostring(z.w) .. "x" .. tostring(z.h)
probes.dpc_aim:
local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json"); if not (ok and d) then return nil end
local a = d.aim; return a and string.format("hold=%s blocked=%s reqs=%s learned=%s off=%s", tostring(a.hold), tostring(a.blocked), tostring(a.reqs), tostring(a.learned), tostring(a.off))
